title: Paired on-prem AD enumeration and cloud directory-read events for one identity
event_type: Sysmon Event ID 1 (Process Create) for a Get-ADUser-style enumeration command, correlated with an Entra ID / Graph API AuditLogs directory-read entry, same identity, same session window

callouts.explanation: The Get-ADUser invocation with a broad filter and privilege-relevant properties (memberof, adminCount) is the on-prem enumeration half of the pair Part 13 §7 already detects at the process-creation level.
The cloud-side directory-role read is the Graph API equivalent enumeration action; on its own it is implicit in Part 18's scope but not a standing detection there.
Resolving SubjectUserName to this UserPrincipalName is the HybridIdentityMap join DET-46-04 depends on — without it, the two events never get tied to the same identity.
The roughly 7-minute gap between OnPremTime and CloudTime falls inside DET-46-04's correlation window, illustrating why the pairing — not either event alone — is the signal worth alerting on.

note: This is an illustrative, conceptual field breakdown of what a paired on-prem/cloud enumeration capture would show, not a captured screenshot from a real AD domain controller or live cloud tenant, and no product interface is depicted.
